S748: Butte's records kb/receipts/program_requirement_records_piles_s742_butte_2026-11-27_s742a.json held, read again by key: collected with their gaps named where the gap is true on the page and the record is the program's own (no reread, no reconcile, no record changed)

batch.what: one pre-read, one guarded UPDATE and one rollback over every member; the UPDATE writes all of the batch's rows or none

gaps.noted_section_cut_off: The reader's note says the program's section runs onto a page the read did not hold, so part of its requirements is missing from the record.

records.words: The catalog text appears cut off after the second program learning outcome (it ends mid-sentence without a period); the nursing course requirements table, unit totals, and any further outcomes are not in the provided text.

outcomes: Adhere to standards of professional practice, and practice within legal, ethical and regulatory frameworks.
Demonstrate effective verbal, non-verbal, and written communication using compassion and cultural awareness resulting in trusting relationship

representation: checks.gaps and checks.confidence added as the load reads the filed score (a passing row: checks.arithmetic to equal); checks.coverage, invented and the record unchanged
claim_check_reads: Today's capture (sources.json): every course an entry names among the codes it found, and a course an entry says the printed total leaves out on neither it nor the state's list. A note's quoted figures are the reader's words, never re-read here; a page read's sentence is committed in its plan file under its run.
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.
